15. Update or Remove HireRight Configuration
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Recruiting Category Provisioning and Configuration.
Locate HireRight in the integrations table.
Click the Edit icon beside the HireRight row.
Locate the Reference Key field.
Set the value to TORS09-PROD.
Locate the Client ID field.
Set the value to TORS09.
Locate the Client Secret field.
Set the value to RCSD053124!.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
